verdict.rationale: Cua documents an official Cua SDK for creating and driving computers from your own code in Python, TypeScript and Rust. The docs also cover runtime backends (Docker/Podman, QEMU, Lume), remote hosts via cua-spacesd, setup tooling, and streaming back to users. The llms.txt probe confirms the SDK as a first-class product. missing for 10: per-language API reference depth, independent hands-on corroboration of the current SDKs (the one community run report concerns an old cua-agent 0.1.29 connection issue, not the SDK's existence), and a published OpenAPI spec (the probe returned 404).
